import {GR86,engineTorqueAt} from './vehicle-spec.js';
// SI units. Force-based deformable chassis, suspension links and unsprung hub nodes.
// Independent reduced node/beam implementation; not BeamNG code or a calibrated GR86.
export const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
export const approach=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*clamp(t,0,1);
export const DT=1/240;
export const defaults={mass:GR86.mass,power:1,grip:1,spring:35000,damper:3200,wet:false,abs:true,tcs:false,drive:'rwd',lsd:true};
const gears=GR86.gears,finalDrive=GR86.finalDrive,radius=GR86.tireRadius,wheelInertia=GR86.wheelInertia,engineInertia=GR86.engineInertia;
// Combined brush adhesion, a smooth sliding transition and tire load sensitivity.
// These generic coefficients require measured tire data before claiming accuracy.
export function tireForce(load,restLoad,mu,kappa,alpha,front=true){
 if(load<=0||mu<=0)return {fx:0,fy:0,limit:0,utilization:0};
 const normalized=clamp(load/restLoad,.08,3.5);
 const effectiveMu=mu*clamp(Math.pow(normalized,-.10),.85,1.16);
 const limit=effectiveMu*load;
 const stiffnessScale=Math.pow(normalized,.80);
 const x=restLoad*23*stiffnessScale*kappa;
 const y=-(front?46000:60000)*stiffnessScale*Math.tan(clamp(alpha,-1.3,1.3));
 const q=Math.hypot(x,y),t=q/(3*limit);
 const amplitude=t<1?limit*(1-Math.pow(1-t,3)):limit*(1-.09*(1-Math.exp(-(t-1)*1.5)));
 const factor=q>1e-8?amplitude/q:0;
 return {fx:x*factor,fy:y*factor,limit,utilization:amplitude/limit};
}
const G=9.81,SUBSTEP=1/1920,UNSPRUNG=38,TIRE_K=220000,TIRE_D=850;
const distance=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y,b.z-a.z);
function normalize(a){const d=Math.hypot(...a)||1;return a.map(v=>v/d);}
function cross(a,b){return [a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1],a[2]*b[0]-a[0]*b[2],a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0]];}
function dot(a,b){return a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1]+a[2]*b[2];}
// Helical limited-slip approximation: torque-dependent friction, equal/opposite
// wheel torques, and a finite bias ratio. No grip multiplier or yaw assistance.
export function differentialTransfer(omegaA,omegaB,totalTorque,h,inertia=wheelInertia,bias=GR86.diffBias){
 const bound=Math.abs(totalTorque)*(bias-1)/(2*(bias+1));
 const freeDifference=omegaA-omegaB;
 return clamp(freeDifference/(2*h/inertia+1/45),-bound,bound);
}
export class Vehicle {
 constructor(terrain=()=>({height:0,grip:1,surface:'asphalt'})){this.terrain=terrain;this.config={...defaults};this.reset();}
 get yawInertia(){let sum=0;for(const n of this.nodes)sum+=n.mass*(n.ox*n.ox+n.oz*n.oz);return sum;}
 reset(x=0,z=0,yaw=0,speed=0){
  Object.assign(this,{x,z,yaw,y:this.terrain(x,z).height+.70,vx:Math.sin(yaw)*speed,vz:Math.cos(yaw)*speed,vy:0,roll:0,pitch:0,rollRate:0,pitchRate:0,yawRate:0,steer:0,throttle:0,brake:0,handbrake:0,gear:1,rpm:900,engineOmega:900*Math.PI/30,clutchTorque:0,clutchEngagement:0,shiftTimer:0,shiftRecovery:false,shiftCooldown:0,time:0,ax:0,ay:0,speed,damage:0,collisionPulse:0,absActive:false,tcsActive:false,plasticRevision:0,brokenBeams:0,bodyContactCount:0,bodyNormalImpulse:0});
  this.basis={right:[Math.cos(yaw),0,-Math.sin(yaw)],up:[0,1,0],forward:[Math.sin(yaw),0,Math.cos(yaw)]};this.nodes=[];this.beams=[];
  const frontZ=GR86.wheelbase*(1-GR86.frontWeight),rearZ=-GR86.wheelbase*GR86.frontWeight;
  const sections=[-2.05,rearZ,-.40,.40,frontZ,2.05],sectionWeights=[.03,.25,.20,.20,.29,.03];
  const moment=sectionWeights.reduce((s,w,i)=>s+w*sections[i],0),square=sectionWeights.reduce((s,w,i)=>s+w*sections[i]**2,0);
  // Adjust node mass distribution so total CG, including four hub masses, sits at z=0.
  const hubMoment=UNSPRUNG*2*(frontZ+rearZ),sprung=this.config.mass-4*UNSPRUNG-32,target=-(hubMoment-8)/sprung,b=(target-moment)/(square-target*moment);
  const adjusted=sectionWeights.map((w,i)=>w*(1+b*sections[i])),sum=adjusted.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  const add=(ox,oy,oz,mass,kind)=>{const sn=Math.sin(yaw),cs=Math.cos(yaw);this.nodes.push({x:x+cs*ox+sn*oz,y:this.y+oy,z:z-sn*ox+cs*oz,ox,oy,oz,mass,baseMass:mass,vx:this.vx,vy:0,vz:this.vz,fx:0,fy:0,fz:0,kind});return this.nodes.length-1;};
  for(let j=0;j<6;j++)for(let level=0;level<2;level++)for(let side of [-1,1])add(side*.55,level?.18:-.32,sections[j],sprung*adjusted[j]/sum*(level?.30:.70)/2,'chassis');
  for(const rz of [-.8,.3])for(const rx of [-.53,.53])add(rx,.55,rz,8,'chassis');
  this.chassisCount=this.nodes.length;this.originalMass=this.config.mass;
  const beam=(a,b,k,damping,yieldForce,breakForce,kind,rest=distance(this.nodes[a],this.nodes[b]))=>{const v={a,b,k,damping,yieldForce,breakForce,kind,rest,original:rest,neutral:distance(this.nodes[a],this.nodes[b]),broken:false,force:0};this.beams.push(v);return v;};
  for(let section=0;section<6;section++){
   for(let a=0;a<4;a++)for(let b=a+1;b<4;b++)beam(section*4+a,section*4+b,1200000,450,100000,350000,'frame');
   if(section<5)for(let a=0;a<4;a++)for(let b=0;b<4;b++){const crush=section===0||section===4;beam(section*4+a,(section+1)*4+b,crush?350000:1200000,crush?350:450,crush?16000:100000,crush?120000:350000,crush?'crumple':'frame');}
  }
  for(let j=24;j<28;j++)for(let k=8;k<16;k++)beam(j,k,1200000,450,100000,350000,'frame');
  this.wheels=[[-GR86.frontTrack/2,frontZ],[GR86.frontTrack/2,frontZ],[-GR86.rearTrack/2,rearZ],[GR86.rearTrack/2,rearZ]].map(([wx,wz],i)=>{
   const section=i<2?4:1,side=i%2,lower=section*4+side,upper=section*4+2+side,innerSection=i<2?3:2;
   const load=this.config.mass*G*(i<2?GR86.frontWeight:1-GR86.frontWeight)/2;
   const gx=x+Math.cos(yaw)*wx+Math.sin(yaw)*wz,gz=z-Math.sin(yaw)*wx+Math.cos(yaw)*wz;
   const wy=this.terrain(gx,gz).height+radius-load/TIRE_K;
   const hub=add(wx,wy-this.y,wz,UNSPRUNG,'hub');
   const arms=[beam(hub,lower,1800000,500,65000,200000,'arm'),beam(hub,innerSection*4+side,1800000,500,65000,200000,'arm')];
   const a=this.nodes[hub],mount=this.nodes[upper],dy=(mount.y-a.y)/distance(a,mount);
   const strut=beam(hub,upper,this.config.spring,this.config.damper,Infinity,Infinity,'strut',distance(a,mount)+(load-UNSPRUNG*G)/(this.config.spring*dy));
   return {x:wx,z:wz,front:i<2,hub,upper,lower,arms,strut,omega:speed/radius,spin:0,slip:0,alpha:0,fx:0,fy:0,load,compression:0,ground:this.terrain(gx,gz).height,groundPrev:this.terrain(gx,gz).height,grip:1,surface:'asphalt',contact:true,toe:0,camber:0,damage:0,steerAngle:0,utilization:0,forceLimit:0,absFactor:1,driveTorque:0};
  });
  if(speed){this.clutchEngagement=1;while(this.gear<6&&Math.abs(speed/radius)*gears[this.gear-1]*finalDrive*30/Math.PI>4500)this.gear++;this.engineOmega=Math.max(this.engineOmega,Math.abs(speed/radius)*gears[this.gear-1]*finalDrive);this.rpm=this.engineOmega*30/Math.PI;}
  this.deformation=new StructuralSkin(this);this.syncPose();
 }
 setVelocity(vx,vy,vz){for(const n of this.nodes){n.vx=vx;n.vy=vy;n.vz=vz;}this.syncPose();}
 lift(height){for(const n of this.nodes)n.y+=height;this.syncPose();}
 syncPose(){
  const n=this.nodes;
  const front=[0,0,0],rear=[0,0,0],right=[0,0,0],up=[0,0,0];
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const a=n[16+i],b=n[4+i];front[0]+=a.x/4;front[1]+=a.y/4;front[2]+=a.z/4;rear[0]+=b.x/4;rear[1]+=b.y/4;rear[2]+=b.z/4;}
  for(let j=1;j<=4;j++)for(let level=0;level<2;level++){const a=n[j*4+level*2],b=n[j*4+level*2+1];right[0]+=(b.x-a.x)/8;right[1]+=(b.y-a.y)/8;right[2]+=(b.z-a.z)/8;}
  let rawRightVelocity=[0,0,0];
  for(let j=1;j<=4;j++)for(let level=0;level<2;level++){const a=n[j*4+level*2],b=n[j*4+level*2+1];rawRightVelocity[0]+=(b.vx-a.vx)/8;rawRightVelocity[1]+=(b.vy-a.vy)/8;rawRightVelocity[2]+=(b.vz-a.vz)/8;}
  let f=normalize(front.map((v,i)=>v-rear[i])),r=normalize(right);let u=normalize(cross(f,r));r=normalize(cross(u,f));this.basis={right:r,up:u,forward:f};
  const radial=dot(rawRightVelocity,r),span=Math.hypot(...right);this.rightRate=rawRightVelocity.map((v,i)=>(v-r[i]*radial)/Math.max(span,.1));
  const oldYaw=this.yaw;const measured=Math.atan2(f[0],f[2]);this.yaw=oldYaw+Math.atan2(Math.sin(measured-oldYaw),Math.cos(measured-oldYaw));this.pitch=-Math.asin(clamp(f[1],-1,1));this.roll=Math.atan2(r[1],u[1]);
  let mass=0;this.x=this.y=this.z=this.vx=this.vy=this.vz=0;
  for(let i=0;i<this.chassisCount;i++){const a=n[i],m=a.mass;mass+=m;this.x+=m*(a.x-r[0]*a.ox-u[0]*a.oy-f[0]*a.oz);this.y+=m*(a.y-r[1]*a.ox-u[1]*a.oy-f[1]*a.oz);this.z+=m*(a.z-r[2]*a.ox-u[2]*a.oy-f[2]*a.oz);this.vx+=m*a.vx;this.vy+=m*a.vy;this.vz+=m*a.vz;}
  this.x/=mass;this.y/=mass;this.z/=mass;this.vx/=mass;this.vy/=mass;this.vz/=mass;this.speed=Math.hypot(this.vx,this.vz);
  // Angular velocity from node momentum. No yaw or roll integration outside nodes.
  let yawNumerator=0,yawDenominator=0;
  for(let i=0;i<this.chassisCount;i++){const a=n[i],dx=a.x-this.x,dz=a.z-this.z;yawNumerator+=a.mass*(dz*(a.vx-this.vx)-dx*(a.vz-this.vz));yawDenominator+=a.mass*(dx*dx+dz*dz);}
  this.yawRate=yawNumerator/Math.max(yawDenominator,1);
  for(const w of this.wheels){const a=n[w.hub],dx=a.x-this.x,dy=a.y-this.y,dz=a.z-this.z;w.local=[dot([dx,dy,dz],r),dot([dx,dy,dz],u),dot([dx,dy,dz],f)];
   const b=n[w.lower],c=n[w.arms[1].b],direction=normalize([b.x-c.x,b.y-c.y,b.z-c.z]);const sign=w.front?1:-1;w.toe=clamp(Math.atan2(dot(direction,r)*sign,dot(direction,f)*sign),-.7,.7);w.camber=0;
   w.damage=Math.max(...w.arms.map(b=>b.broken?1:Math.abs(b.rest/b.original-1)));
  }
  this.brokenBeams=this.beams.filter(b=>b.broken).length;this.damage=this.deformation?.measure()||0;
 }
 step(h,input){this.refreshContactPlanes();h=clamp(h,1/4000,1/30);const count=Math.ceil(h/SUBSTEP-1e-8);for(let i=0;i<count;i++)this.integrate(h/count,input);this.syncPose();}
 applyBeam(b,h){
  if(b.broken)return;
  const a=this.nodes[b.a],c=this.nodes[b.b],dx=c.x-a.x,dy=c.y-a.y,dz=c.z-a.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz)||1,ex=dx/d,ey=dy/d,ez=dz/d;
  let strain=d-b.rest,elastic=b.k*strain;
  if(Math.abs(elastic)>b.breakForce){b.broken=true;this.plasticRevision++;return;}
  if(Math.abs(elastic)>b.yieldForce){const change=(strain-Math.sign(strain)*b.yieldForce/b.k)*(1-Math.exp(-h*100));b.rest=clamp(b.rest+change,b.original*.20,b.original*1.8);strain=d-b.rest;this.plasticRevision++;}
  const relative=(c.vx-a.vx)*ex+(c.vy-a.vy)*ey+(c.vz-a.vz)*ez;
  let force=b.k*strain+b.damping*relative;
  if(b.kind==='strut'){
   const bump=b.neutral-.055,droop=b.neutral+.085;
   if(d<bump)force+=350000*(d-bump)+4000*Math.min(relative,0);
   if(d>droop)force+=350000*(d-droop)+4000*Math.max(relative,0);
  }
  b.force=force;
  a.fx+=force*ex;a.fy+=force*ey;a.fz+=force*ez;c.fx-=force*ex;c.fy-=force*ey;c.fz-=force*ez;
 }
 integrate(h,input){
  this.time+=h;this.collisionPulse*=Math.exp(-h*5);this.shiftTimer=Math.max(0,this.shiftTimer-h);this.shiftCooldown=Math.max(0,this.shiftCooldown-h);
  const cfg=this.config,u=this.vx*this.basis.forward[0]+this.vz*this.basis.forward[2];
  if(cfg.mass!==this.originalMass){const scale=(cfg.mass-4*UNSPRUNG)/(this.originalMass-4*UNSPRUNG);for(let i=0;i<this.chassisCount;i++)this.nodes[i].mass*=scale;this.originalMass=cfg.mass;}
  this.throttle=approach(this.throttle,clamp(input.gas||0,0,1),1-Math.exp(-h/.22));this.brake=approach(this.brake,clamp(input.brake||0,0,1),1-Math.exp(-h/.08));this.handbrake=input.handbrake||0;this.steer+=clamp(-clamp(input.steer||0,-1,1)*.57-this.steer,-3*h,3*h);
  const reverse=!!input.reverse,weights=cfg.drive==='fwd'?[.5,.5,0,0]:cfg.drive==='awd'?[.25,.25,.25,.25]:[0,0,.5,.5];
  let ratio=(reverse?-GR86.reverseRatio:gears[this.gear-1])*finalDrive;
  const avgOmega=this.wheels.reduce((sum,w,i)=>sum+w.omega*weights[i],0);
  const connectedRPM=Math.abs(avgOmega*ratio)*30/Math.PI;
  if(!reverse&&this.shiftCooldown<=0&&this.shiftTimer<=0){
   if(this.rpm>7200&&connectedRPM>6200&&this.gear<6){this.gear++;this.shiftRecovery=true;this.shiftTimer=.23;this.shiftCooldown=.9;}
   else if(this.gear>1&&connectedRPM<1900){this.gear--;this.shiftRecovery=true;this.shiftTimer=.20;this.shiftCooldown=.7;}
  }
  if(this.shiftTimer>0)this.clutchEngagement=0;
  ratio=(reverse?-GR86.reverseRatio:gears[this.gear-1])*finalDrive;
  if(this.shiftTimer<=0&&Math.abs(this.engineOmega-ratio*avgOmega)<25&&this.clutchEngagement>.9)this.shiftRecovery=false;
  const driveSign=reverse?-1:1;
  const rearLateralUse=Math.max(...this.wheels.filter((w,i)=>weights[i]).map(w=>Math.abs(w.fy)/Math.max(w.forceLimit,1)));
  const tractionTarget=Math.max(.025,.10*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-rearLateralUse*rearLateralUse)));
  const worstSlip=Math.max(...this.wheels.map((w,i)=>weights[i]?w.slip*driveSign:0));
  this.tcsActive=cfg.tcs&&this.throttle>.05&&worstSlip>tractionTarget;
  const throttle=this.throttle*(this.tcsActive?clamp(1-(worstSlip-tractionTarget)*12,0,1):1);
  const friction=17+this.engineOmega*.035;
  const combustion=this.rpm<7500&&this.shiftTimer<=0&&!this.shiftRecovery?throttle*(engineTorqueAt(this.rpm)+friction)*cfg.power:0;
  const idleControl=this.engineOmega<900*Math.PI/30+1?clamp(friction+(900*Math.PI/30-this.engineOmega)*2,0,95):0;
  const engineTorque=combustion+idleControl-friction;
  // Automatic clutch driver holds a modest launch speed rather than immediately
  // dumping the clutch at idle. It does not alter grip or vehicle yaw.
  const launch=clamp((this.rpm-(850+this.throttle*650))/650,0,1);
  const engagement=this.shiftTimer>0?0:Math.abs(u)>3?1:(this.throttle<.02||this.brake>.3&&this.throttle<.1?0:launch);
  this.clutchEngagement=approach(this.clutchEngagement,engagement,1-Math.exp(-h/.10));
  const clutchK=30*this.clutchEngagement,capacity=(this.shiftRecovery?180:340)*this.clutchEngagement;
  const wheelSideFree=this.wheels.reduce((sum,w,i)=>sum+weights[i]*(w.omega-h*w.fx*radius/wheelInertia),0);
  const freeEngine=this.engineOmega+h*engineTorque/engineInertia;
  // Implicit torsion clutch couples flywheel and reflected wheel inertia.
  const inverseWheelI=weights.reduce((sum,w)=>sum+w*w/wheelInertia,0);
  const clutch=clutchK>1e-5?clamp((freeEngine-ratio*wheelSideFree)/(1/clutchK+h*(1/engineInertia+ratio*ratio*inverseWheelI)),-capacity,capacity):0;
  this.clutchTorque=clutch;this.engineOmega=clamp(freeEngine-h*clutch/engineInertia,40,7600*Math.PI/30);this.rpm=this.engineOmega*30/Math.PI;
  const torques=weights.map(w=>clutch*ratio*.92*w);
  if(cfg.lsd){for(const [a,b] of [[0,1],[2,3]])if(weights[a]&&weights[b]){const wa=this.wheels[a],wb=this.wheels[b],freeA=wa.omega-h*wa.fx*radius/wheelInertia,freeB=wb.omega-h*wb.fx*radius/wheelInertia;const coupling=differentialTransfer(freeA,freeB,torques[a]+torques[b],h);torques[a]-=coupling;torques[b]+=coupling;}}
  for(const n of this.nodes){n.fx=0;n.fy=-n.mass*G;n.fz=0;}
  for(const w of this.wheels){w.strut.k=cfg.spring;w.strut.damping=cfg.damper;}
  for(const b of this.beams)this.applyBeam(b,h);
  // Anti-roll force is an internal load between the two struts, with equal reactions.
  for(const [a,b,k] of [[0,1,6500],[2,3,4500]]){
   const wa=this.wheels[a],wb=this.wheels[b],da=wa.strut.rest-distance(this.nodes[wa.hub],this.nodes[wa.upper]),db=wb.strut.rest-distance(this.nodes[wb.hub],this.nodes[wb.upper]),transfer=(da-db)*k;
   for(const [w,force]of [[wa,-transfer],[wb,transfer]]){const p=this.nodes[w.hub],q=this.nodes[w.upper],d=distance(p,q),dx=(q.x-p.x)/d,dy=(q.y-p.y)/d,dz=(q.z-p.z)/d;p.fx+=force*dx;p.fy+=force*dy;p.fz+=force*dz;q.fx-=force*dx;q.fy-=force*dy;q.fz-=force*dz;}
  }
  this.absActive=false;this.coupleX=this.coupleY=this.coupleZ=0;
  // A single hub plus two coplanar rods leaves a carrier rotation mode.
  // Lateral carrier compliance supplies the missing upright constraint;
  // equal reactions at the hub location conserve total force and moment.
  let cx=0,cy=0,cz=0;for(let j=0;j<this.chassisCount;j++){const b=this.nodes[j],share=b.mass/(cfg.mass-4*UNSPRUNG);cx+=b.x*share;cy+=b.y*share;cz+=b.z*share;}
  for(const w of this.wheels){
   if(w.arms.some(b=>b.broken))continue;
   const n=this.nodes[w.hub],a=this.nodes[w.lower],r=this.basis.right;
   const error=dot([n.x-a.x,n.y-a.y,n.z-a.z],r)-(w.x-a.ox);
   const rate=dot([n.vx-a.vx,n.vy-a.vy,n.vz-a.vz],r)+dot([n.x-a.x,n.y-a.y,n.z-a.z],this.rightRate);
   const force=-300000*error-3500*rate;
   const fx=r[0]*force,fy=r[1]*force,fz=r[2]*force;
   n.fx+=fx;n.fy+=fy;n.fz+=fz;
   for(let j=0;j<this.chassisCount;j++){const b=this.nodes[j],share=b.mass/(cfg.mass-4*UNSPRUNG);b.fx-=fx*share;b.fy-=fy*share;b.fz-=fz*share;}
   this.applyCouple(cross([n.x-cx,n.y-cy,n.z-cz],[-fx,-fy,-fz]));
  }

  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
   const w=this.wheels[i],n=this.nodes[w.hub],plane=w.plane,ground={height:plane.height+plane.gx*(n.x-plane.x)+plane.gz*(n.z-plane.z),grip:plane.grip,surface:plane.surface};w.ground=w.groundPrev=ground.height;w.surface=ground.surface;
   const normal=plane.normal;
   const penetration=(ground.height+radius-n.y)*normal[1],vn=dot([n.vx,n.vy,n.vz],normal);
   w.contact=penetration>0;w.load=w.contact?Math.max(0,penetration*TIRE_K-vn*TIRE_D):0;
   w.grip=ground.grip*cfg.grip*(cfg.wet?.64:1);w.compression=w.strut.rest-distance(n,this.nodes[w.upper]);
   n.fx+=normal[0]*w.load;n.fy+=normal[1]*w.load;n.fz+=normal[2]*w.load;
   const turnRadius=Math.abs(this.steer)>1e-5?GR86.wheelbase/Math.tan(this.steer):Infinity;w.steerAngle=w.front&&Number.isFinite(turnRadius)?Math.atan(GR86.wheelbase/(turnRadius-w.x)):0;
   const angle=w.steerAngle+w.toe,sa=Math.sin(angle),ca=Math.cos(angle),f=this.basis.forward,r=this.basis.right;
   let forward=[f[0]*ca+r[0]*sa,f[1]*ca+r[1]*sa,f[2]*ca+r[2]*sa];const projection=dot(forward,normal);forward=normalize(forward.map((v,j)=>v-normal[j]*projection));const lateral=normalize(cross(normal,forward));
   const long=dot([n.vx,n.vy,n.vz],forward),lat=dot([n.vx,n.vy,n.vz],lateral),transport=Math.max(Math.abs(long),2);
   const slip=(w.omega*radius-long)/Math.max(Math.abs(long),2),alpha=Math.atan2(lat,Math.max(Math.abs(long),1));
   w.slip=approach(w.slip,clamp(slip,-5,5),1-Math.exp(-h*transport/.25));w.alpha=approach(w.alpha,alpha,1-Math.exp(-h*transport/.30));
   const force=tireForce(w.load,GR86.mass*G*(w.front?GR86.frontWeight:1-GR86.frontWeight)/2,w.grip,w.slip,w.alpha,w.front);
   w.fx=w.contact?force.fx:0;w.fy=w.contact?force.fy:0;w.forceLimit=force.limit;w.utilization=force.utilization;
   let braking=this.brake*(w.front?1550:1050);
   const targetABS=cfg.abs&&this.brake>.02&&Math.abs(long)>2&&Math.sign(long)*w.slip<-.13?.12:1;
   w.absFactor=approach(w.absFactor,targetABS,1-Math.exp(-h/.018));if(this.brake>.02&&w.absFactor<.85)this.absActive=true;braking*=w.absFactor;
   if(!w.front)braking+=this.handbrake*2600;
   // Brake-based traction control arrests wheel spin while combustion torque
   // and flywheel speed respond. It acts through wheel torque, never chassis yaw.
   if(cfg.tcs&&weights[i]&&this.throttle>.02&&!this.handbrake){
    const lateralUse=clamp(Math.abs(w.fy)/Math.max(w.forceLimit,1),0,1);
    const targetSlip=Math.max(.035,.105*Math.sqrt(1-lateralUse*lateralUse));
    const excess=w.slip*driveSign-targetSlip;
    if(excess>0){braking+=clamp(excess*6500,0,1600);this.tcsActive=true;}
   }
   w.driveTorque=torques[i];
   let omega=w.omega+(torques[i]-w.fx*radius-w.omega*.045)/wheelInertia*h;
   omega=Math.sign(omega)*Math.max(0,Math.abs(omega)-braking/wheelInertia*h);
   w.omega=clamp(omega,-500,500);w.spin+=w.omega*h;
   const resistance=w.load*(w.surface==='grass'?.045:w.surface==='gravel'?.026:.011)*Math.tanh(long*3);
   n.fx+=(w.fx-resistance)*forward[0]+w.fy*lateral[0];n.fy+=(w.fx-resistance)*forward[1]+w.fy*lateral[1];n.fz+=(w.fx-resistance)*forward[2]+w.fy*lateral[2];
   // Tire forces applied at the road contact point produce a moment about hub.
   // This reaction couple transfers through the chassis without scripted load shifts.
   const rx=-radius*normal[0],ry=-radius*normal[1],rz=-radius*normal[2],tx=w.fx*forward[0]+w.fy*lateral[0],ty=w.fx*forward[1]+w.fy*lateral[1],tz=w.fx*forward[2]+w.fy*lateral[2];
   this.applyCouple([ry*tz-rz*ty,rz*tx-rx*tz,rx*ty-ry*tx]);
  }
  this.distributeCouple();
  const drag=.5*1.225*GR86.dragArea*this.speed;
  for(let i=0;i<this.chassisCount;i++){const n=this.nodes[i],share=n.mass/(cfg.mass-4*UNSPRUNG);n.fx-=this.vx*drag*share;n.fz-=this.vz*drag*share;}
  const oldVX=this.vx,oldVZ=this.vz;
  for(const n of this.nodes){n.vx+=n.fx/n.mass*h;n.vy+=n.fy/n.mass*h;n.vz+=n.fz/n.mass*h;n.x+=n.vx*h;n.y+=n.vy*h;n.z+=n.vz*h;}
  this.groundChassis(h);this.syncPose();
  this.ax=approach(this.ax,((this.vx-oldVX)*this.basis.forward[0]+(this.vz-oldVZ)*this.basis.forward[2])/h,1-Math.exp(-h*6));this.ay=approach(this.ay,((this.vx-oldVX)*this.basis.right[0]+(this.vz-oldVZ)*this.basis.right[2])/h,1-Math.exp(-h*6));
 }
 applyCouple(torque){this.coupleX+=torque[0];this.coupleY+=torque[1];this.coupleZ+=torque[2];}
 distributeCouple(){
  // Solve I * angularAcceleration = torque, then distribute a pure force couple.
  // This applies a tire contact moment to mass nodes; it never changes pose directly.
  let cx=0,cy=0,cz=0,mass=0;
  for(let i=0;i<this.chassisCount;i++){const n=this.nodes[i];mass+=n.mass;cx+=n.x*n.mass;cy+=n.y*n.mass;cz+=n.z*n.mass;}cx/=mass;cy/=mass;cz/=mass;
  let a=0,b=0,c=0,d=0,e=0,f=0;
  for(let i=0;i<this.chassisCount;i++){const n=this.nodes[i],x=n.x-cx,y=n.y-cy,z=n.z-cz,m=n.mass;a+=m*(y*y+z*z);d+=m*(x*x+z*z);f+=m*(x*x+y*y);b-=m*x*y;c-=m*x*z;e-=m*y*z;}
  const det=a*(d*f-e*e)-b*(b*f-c*e)+c*(b*e-c*d);if(Math.abs(det)<1)return;
  const tx=this.coupleX,ty=this.coupleY,tz=this.coupleZ;
  const wx=((d*f-e*e)*tx+(c*e-b*f)*ty+(b*e-c*d)*tz)/det,wy=((c*e-b*f)*tx+(a*f-c*c)*ty+(b*c-a*e)*tz)/det,wz=((b*e-c*d)*tx+(b*c-a*e)*ty+(a*d-b*b)*tz)/det;
  for(let i=0;i<this.chassisCount;i++){const n=this.nodes[i],x=n.x-cx,y=n.y-cy,z=n.z-cz;n.fx+=n.mass*(wy*z-wz*y);n.fy+=n.mass*(wz*x-wx*z);n.fz+=n.mass*(wx*y-wy*x);}
 }
 refreshContactPlanes(){
  let highest=-Infinity;
  for(const w of this.wheels){
   const n=this.nodes[w.hub],yaw=this.yaw+(w.front?this.steer:0)+w.toe,sn=Math.sin(yaw),cs=Math.cos(yaw),a=.15,b=GR86.tireWidth*.42;
   const g=this.terrain(n.x,n.z),fore=this.terrain(n.x+sn*a,n.z+cs*a),aft=this.terrain(n.x-sn*a,n.z-cs*a),right=this.terrain(n.x+cs*b,n.z-sn*b),left=this.terrain(n.x-cs*b,n.z+sn*b);
   // A finite footprint bridges surface boundaries. Five road samples define an
   // effective support plane and mixed-surface grip; this is not a pressure tire.
   const height=.4*g.height+.15*(fore.height+aft.height+right.height+left.height);
   const longitudinal=(fore.height-aft.height)/(2*a),lateral=(right.height-left.height)/(2*b);
   const gx=longitudinal*sn+lateral*cs,gz=longitudinal*cs-lateral*sn;
   const grip=.4*g.grip+.15*(fore.grip+aft.grip+right.grip+left.grip);
   w.plane={x:n.x,z:n.z,height,grip,surface:g.surface,gx,gz,normal:normalize([-gx,1,-gz])};highest=Math.max(highest,height);
  }
  const nearGround=this.nodes.slice(0,this.chassisCount).some(n=>n.y<highest+.15);
  this.bodyContacts=nearGround?this.nodes.slice(0,this.chassisCount).map(n=>this.terrain(n.x,n.z).height+.045):null;
 }
 groundChassis(h){
  // Node impulses use the actual incoming normal momentum, including loads
  // transmitted through the beams. Roof nodes now cover the passenger cage.
  this.bodyContactCount=0;this.bodyNormalImpulse=0;
  if(!this.bodyContacts)return;
  for(let i=0;i<this.chassisCount;i++){
   const n=this.nodes[i],ground=this.bodyContacts[i];
   if(n.y<ground){
    this.bodyContactCount++;n.y=ground;
    const impulse=Math.max(0,-n.vy*n.mass);this.bodyNormalImpulse+=impulse;
    if(n.vy<0)n.vy=0;
    const speed=Math.hypot(n.vx,n.vz),change=Math.min(speed,.65*impulse/n.mass);
    if(speed>1e-8){n.vx*=1-change/speed;n.vz*=1-change/speed;}
   }
  }
 }
 collideCircle(ox,oz,obstacleRadius,height=2.8,obstacle=null){
  const contact=(px,pz,nx,nz)=>{if(!obstacle)return {inv:0,v:0,lever:0};const rx=px-obstacle.x,rz=pz-obstacle.z,lever=rz*nx-rx*nz;return {inv:1/obstacle.mass+lever*lever/obstacle.inertia,v:obstacle.vx*nx+obstacle.vz*nz+obstacle.yawRate*lever,lever};};
  const react=(j,nx,nz,c)=>{if(obstacle){obstacle.vx-=nx*j/obstacle.mass;obstacle.vz-=nz*j/obstacle.mass;obstacle.yawRate-=j*c.lever/obstacle.inertia;}};
  let hit=false;const base=this.terrain(ox,oz).height;
  // Capsules along structural beams cover gaps between coarse mass nodes.
  for(const b of this.beams){
   if(b.broken||b.kind==='arm'||b.kind==='strut')continue;
   const a=this.nodes[b.a],c=this.nodes[b.b],dx=c.x-a.x,dz=c.z-a.z,length2=dx*dx+dz*dz;if(length2<1e-6)continue;
   const t=clamp(((ox-a.x)*dx+(oz-a.z)*dz)/length2,0,1),px=a.x+dx*t,pz=a.z+dz*t,py=a.y+(c.y-a.y)*t;if(py<base-.1||py>base+height)continue;
   const sx=px-ox,sz=pz-oz,d=Math.hypot(sx,sz),limit=obstacleRadius+.08;if(d>=limit||d<1e-7)continue;
   const nx=sx/d,nz=sz/d,wa=1-t,wb=t,other=contact(px,pz,nx,nz),effective=wa*wa/a.mass+wb*wb/c.mass+other.inv,closing=(wa*a.vx+wb*c.vx)*nx+(wa*a.vz+wb*c.vz)*nz-other.v;
   const correction=Math.min(.10,limit-d)/effective;a.x+=nx*correction*wa/a.mass;a.z+=nz*correction*wa/a.mass;c.x+=nx*correction*wb/c.mass;c.z+=nz*correction*wb/c.mass;
   if(closing<0){const impulse=-1.04*closing/effective;a.vx+=nx*impulse*wa/a.mass;a.vz+=nz*impulse*wa/a.mass;c.vx+=nx*impulse*wb/c.mass;c.vz+=nz*impulse*wb/c.mass;react(impulse,nx,nz,other);this.collisionPulse=Math.max(this.collisionPulse,Math.min(1,-closing/22));hit=true;}
  }
  for(const n of this.nodes){if(n.y<base-.1||n.y>base+height)continue;const dx=n.x-ox,dz=n.z-oz,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz),limit=obstacleRadius+(n.kind==='hub'?radius:.20);if(d>=limit||d<1e-7)continue;
   const nx=dx/d,nz=dz/d,other=contact(n.x,n.z,nx,nz),closing=n.vx*nx+n.vz*nz-other.v;n.x+=nx*(limit-d);n.z+=nz*(limit-d);
   if(closing<0){const impulse=-closing*1.04/(1/n.mass+other.inv);n.vx+=nx*impulse/n.mass;n.vz+=nz*impulse/n.mass;react(impulse,nx,nz,other);this.collisionPulse=Math.max(this.collisionPulse,Math.min(1,-closing/22));hit=true;}
  }
  if(hit){for(const b of this.beams){if(b.broken||b.kind==='strut')continue;const d=distance(this.nodes[b.a],this.nodes[b.b]),elastic=(d-b.rest)*b.k;if(Math.abs(elastic)>b.breakForce){b.broken=true;this.plasticRevision++;}else if(Math.abs(elastic)>b.yieldForce){b.rest=clamp(d-Math.sign(elastic)*b.yieldForce/b.k,b.original*.2,b.original*1.8);this.plasticRevision++;}}this.syncPose();}
  return hit;
 }
 state(){return {x:this.x,z:this.z,speed:this.speed,yaw:this.yaw,rpm:this.rpm,gear:this.gear,damage:this.damage,loads:this.wheels.map(w=>w.load),slips:this.wheels.map(w=>w.slip),roll:this.roll,pitch:this.pitch,nodes:this.nodes.length,beams:this.beams.length,broken:this.brokenBeams};}
}
class StructuralSkin{
 constructor(vehicle){this.vehicle=vehicle;this.nodes=vehicle.nodes;this.beams=vehicle.beams;this.damage=0;this.revision=0;}
 measure(){this.damage=0;for(const b of this.beams)if(b.kind!=='strut')this.damage=Math.max(this.damage,b.broken?.5:Math.abs(b.rest-b.original));this.revision=this.vehicle.plasticRevision;return this.damage;}
 offset(x,y,z){
  const v=this.vehicle,r=v.basis.right,u=v.basis.up,f=v.basis.forward;let dx=0,dy=0,dz=0,sum=0;
  for(let i=0;i<v.chassisCount;i++){const n=v.nodes[i],weight=1/((x-n.ox)**2+(y-n.oy)**2+(z-n.oz)**2+.08)**2,delta=[n.x-v.x,n.y-v.y,n.z-v.z];dx+=(dot(delta,r)-n.ox)*weight;dy+=(dot(delta,u)-n.oy)*weight;dz+=(dot(delta,f)-n.oz)*weight;sum+=weight;}
  return [dx/sum,dy/sum,dz/sum];
 }
}
